environment.description: Celery worker deployed on EC2 instances in a private subnet (10.0.2.0/24) with a NAT Gateway (nat-0a1b2c3d4e5f) attached to the route table, allowing outbound internet access. Redis cluster is accessible at redis-cluster:6379. Workers process tasks from any authenticated API user. No URL allowlisting on webhook or destination parameters.

config.task_queue_auth: any authenticated user can enqueue tasks
